automatic_defaults.only_when: an FDR threshold is appropriate and user did not specify one

must_ask_or_require: organism when organism-specific resource is used
genome assembly for real coordinate-based data
data source: provided, synthetic, or package demo
population/sample size when it determines design
never_infer: real data from a synthetic request
clinical risk from a genetic simulation
a mating scheme from the word inbreeding
gene-level differential expression from a splicing request
